classification.difficultyReason: Uses equal tangent lengths successively at three vertices.

content.prompt: $PQ$, $QR$ and $RP$ are tangents. If $PR=9\text{ cm}$, $RW=5\text{ cm}$ and $RQ=12\text{ cm}$, find $PQ$.

spec.description: Schematic circumscribed triangle with all three contact points marked; source decorative hues replaced by black.
spec.mathematics: PR and PQ touch the circle at W and U; RQ touches it at V. Coordinates establish exact tangency without implying numerical scale.
spec.answerVisibility: No answers or additional numerical givens.

answer.worked:
Tangents from the same external point are equal.
$$\begin{align*}PU=PW&=9-5=4\text{ cm}\\RV&=RW=5\text{ cm}\\QU=QV&=12-5=7\text{ cm}\\PQ&=4+7=11\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
